fills.reason: The daily auto-backup worker writes every receipt (date, amount, merchant, city) as a plaintext CSV into the app's files dir, and backup_rules.xml / data_extraction_rules.xml exclude only the three SharedPreferences files, so this CSV and receipts.db are not excluded from cloud backup or device transfer. Only the note column is encrypted. Judge whether this data counts as sensitive for your threat model; confirm at runtime.

evidence.detail: Plaintext CSV of all receipts written to filesDir/backup.
Backup rules exclude only SharedPreferences files; files/backup and the database are still backed up.

fills.reason: No external storage permissions or APIs. CSV export goes through the Storage Access Framework (CreateDocument), and shared images are copied to the app cache and exposed via a non-exported FileProvider.
No hardcoded crypto keys. AES keys are generated in AndroidKeyStore. The only hardcoded token is the Mixpanel project token, which is an analytics identifier, not a key.
No android.util.Log, println or Timber calls in app or sync modules. OkHttp HttpLoggingInterceptor is added only when BuildConfig.DEBUG, at BASIC level with Authorization redacted.
The only WebView (HelpActivity) sets allowContentAccess = false.
The only WebView (HelpActivity) sets allowFileAccess = false and loads only https help-host pages.
Text inputs hold email, amount, merchant and a note; none is a password or other credential field and the password uses a secure text field. No sensitive-keyboard-cache issue found statically.
No FLAG_SECURE, setRecentsScreenshotEnabled or other screen-capture protection anywhere. Expense lists and private notes are shown in the clear, so decide whether those screens need protection.
No NotificationManager or NotificationCompat usage in any module (searched all .kt files in app and sync).
The password field uses OutlinedSecureTextField, which masks input. No plain text field holds authentication secrets.
One JavaScript interface (HelpBridge) exposing only appVersion() and close(). It is attached to a WebView that navigates only to https://help.pennyjar.example; other URLs go to the external browser.
No filterTouchesWhenObscured or other overlay protection references. Decide whether the unlock and delete-account actions need tapjacking protection.
Internal navigation uses an explicit Intent(context, HelpActivity::class.java). Remaining implicit intents are user-facing ones (share chooser, browser).

Implicit intents are ACTION_SEND through a user-chosen chooser (share link text, receipt image through FileProvider with read grant) and ACTION_VIEW of the privacy policy URL. All user-initiated; no tokens or credentials in extras.
No PendingIntent usage in any module.
The only deep link is the custom scheme pennyjar://help. No https App Links or autoVerify declared.

HelpActivity takes page from the pennyjar://help query or an extra, but only loads it in the WebView when scheme is https and host is help.pennyjar.example. Anything else is passed to the browser only if http(s). A crafted link can still make the app open an arbitrary http(s) URL in the browser (low risk).
Tokens and secrets use SecureRandom (ShareLinks, BiometricGate). The only java.util.Random use seeds avatar colours from a name hash, which is non-security.
No security-relevant values derived from time, hash codes or other non-random sources. Share tokens are 16 SecureRandom bytes.
AES keys are 256-bit. No RSA or EC key generation.
Only AES is used for encryption (AES/GCM/NoPadding). No DES, RC4, Blowfish or similar.
All transformations are AES/GCM/NoPadding; keys are restricted to BLOCK_MODE_GCM. No ECB or unauthenticated CBC.

No KeyguardManager checks, but the sensitive key (app_unlock) is created with setUserAuthenticationRequired(true), which fails without a secure lock screen (caught as GeneralSecurityException), and BiometricManager.canAuthenticate is checked.
No asymmetric key pairs are generated or used; only AES SecretKeys.
Cipher.getInstance is called without a provider argument. Provider name appears only as AndroidKeyStore for KeyGenerator/KeyStore, which is the documented usage.
Biometric unlock is bound to a Keystore key through BiometricPrompt.CryptoObject, and the result is used from result.cryptoObject.
The unlock key sets setInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment(true).
No setConfirmationRequired(false) or other implicit-authentication options. Keys require user authentication per use.
setUserAuthenticationParameters(0, AUTH_BIOMETRIC_STRONG) on API 30+ and validity duration -1 below, so authentication is required for every use.
Prompt allows BIOMETRIC_STRONG only, with a negative button; no DEVICE_CREDENTIAL fallback.
No SSLContext, ConnectionSpec or protocol lists set in code; OkHttp defaults apply.

Release endpoints are all https (API_BASE_URL, upload, images, share, privacy policy). The only http:// URL is the debug build type's 10.0.2.2 emulator address (sync/build.gradle.kts:17), which is not in the release variant.
No SSLSocket or raw socket use; all traffic goes through OkHttp.
No custom X509TrustManager or SSLSocketFactory.
No custom HostnameVerifier.
HelpActivity's WebViewClient does not override onReceivedSslError, so the default (cancel) applies.
No ProviderInstaller or Play Services dependency. minSdk 26 devices may carry an old system TLS provider; decide whether that matters. OkHttp 5.x is bundled.
minSdk is 26 (Android 8.0); no code enforces a newer platform version. Build.VERSION.SDK_INT is used only for API-level branches. Decide whether the minimum is acceptable.
No in-app update APIs (AppUpdateManager) or dependency found. The app has no update-enforcement mechanism in code; whether you need one, or enforce it from the server, is a product decision.
No native code: no NDK, CMake, jniLibs or .so files in either module.
No native code in the project.
The project does not generate an SBOM (no CycloneDX plugin or committed SBOM). Generate one and scan it, including transitive dependencies.
No ObjectInputStream or Serializable-based parsing. API responses are parsed with Gson into fixed classes.
No integrity checks (HMAC, signatures) on stored data such as receipts.db, the backup CSV or cached thumbnails. Decide whether tampering with local data matters.
ReceiptsProvider is not exported and builds queries with bound arguments (rawQuery with ?, id = ?). Selection and projection from callers are ignored.
shouldOverrideUrlLoading allows only https://help.pennyjar.example and hands other URLs to the browser (http/https only).
No manifest meta-data or setSafeBrowsingEnabled(false); SafeBrowsing stays at its default (on).
No setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled call anywhere.

Mixpanel 8.12.1 is the only analytics SDK. It is created with optOutTrackingDefault=true and enabled only after consent; events carry category, amount band and boolean flags, and the user ID is passed to identify(). Check Mixpanel's own data collection (automatic events are on) against your privacy declarations.
No signingConfig in the Gradle files, so the signature scheme versions depend on the signing setup and the built APK; check with apksigner verify.
No signingConfig in the Gradle files, so the key size is unknown; check the release keystore.
No StrictMode references in the code.
No native binaries in the project.
No root detection code found (no su, RootBeer or Play Integrity references). Resilience is an R-profile goal; decide whether the app needs it.
No debugger detection (isDebuggerConnected or similar). Resilience is an R-profile goal; decide whether the app needs it.
Release enables R8 minification and resource shrinking with proguard-android-optimize.txt; the only custom rule keeps the JavaScript-interface methods. No -dontobfuscate.
No native code in the project.
